instruction: Can you make the blurry background perfectly sharp and in focus, matching the foreground detail level?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because depth-of-field blur is a result of optical physics during photo capture. The out-of-focus background data was never captured with the same detail as the foreground - you cannot recover information that was never recorded. True deblurring beyond simple sharpening is impossible without the original scene data.
